faq.q: When should I pack my bag?
faq.a: Pack it the night before, after homework. Mornings are busy, and evenings are calmer. Put the bag by the door.

faq.q: What if I still forget something?
faq.a: That is okay, everyone forgets sometimes. Add a picture of that thing to your list, so you remember next time.

faq.q: What should be in my school bag?
faq.a: Usually a reading book, a pencil case, a water bottle, your lunch and any homework. Your school might add things, like a PE kit on sport days.
asks: Tell me about In my bag

faq.q: Why do some things stay at home?
faq.a: Big toys and games can get lost or damaged at school, and they pull your attention away from learning. They wait at home for you.
asks: Tell me about Stays at home

faq.q: How can I remember special days?
faq.a: Ask a grown-up to add a picture for special days, like a shoe for PE on Tuesday. A grown-up you trust can help you plan.

facts: Packing the night before means fewer things to remember in the busy morning.
A picture list by the door is a reminder you see as you leave.
